description_en: You can invoke MuteCall to mute the call associated with a specified call ID under a specified instance. This operation can only be invoked by an agent who is in a talking state, and the agent can only mute themselves. After the agent mutes themselves, the customer will no longer hear the agent's voice
description_zh: 调用MuteCall静音指定实例下指定通话ID对应的通话，只能由正在通话状态的坐席调用，且只能静音调用者自己，坐席静音后，客户将无法听见坐席的声音
kebab_example: aliyun ccc mute-call --instance-id ccc-test --user-id agent@ccc-test --device-id device --job-id job-65815360847220000 --channel-id ch:user:13188880000-_80010000:1609253204816:job-65815360847220000 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MuteCall

parameters.description_en: The agent ID to be muted.
parameters.help_en: The agent ID to be muted
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.description_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value.
parameters.description_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写。
parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.description_en: The ID of the voice channel to be muted. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. If it is empty, the voice channel of the agent corresponding to UserId will be muted.
parameters.description_zh: 待静音的话务通道ID，非必填，默认为空，为空表示静音UserId对应的坐席的话务通道。
parameters.help_en: The ID of the voice channel to be muted. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. If it is empty, the voice channel of the agent corresponding to UserId will be muted
parameters.help_zh: 待静音的话务通道ID，非必填，默认为空，为空表示静音UserId对应的坐席的话务通道
